description: Data Consistency & Financial Calculation Bug Fixes - Fix critical bugs affecting auth, parlay display, crash prevention, and data consistency.

userStories.title: Fix Player Login Creating Bookie Record
userStories.description: As a player, I need to log in and be recognized as a player, not incorrectly assigned as a bookie.
acceptanceCriteria: In AuthManager.swift, modify ensureBookieRecord() to check if user is a player BEFORE attempting to create a bookie record
Add async method to check if a player record exists in Supabase for the current auth user ID (query players table where auth_user_id matches)

Update role determination logic: 1) Try fetch bookie -> if found, set bookie role, 2) Try check player exists -> if found, set player role, 3) Only create bookie if this is an explicit signup (add isBookieSignup: Bool parameter defaulting to false)
In the auth listener signedIn case, call ensureBookieRecord(isBookieSignup: false) for logins
Rename ensureBookieRecord to determineUserRole for clarity
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Fix Parlay Stake Display Bug
userStories.description: As a player, I need parlay stakes to display correctly so that a 2-leg $25 parlay shows as $25 total, not $50.
acceptanceCriteria: In TrackView.swift, fix Ticket.totalStake computed property (line 16) to return bets.first?.stake when isParlay is true, otherwise sum all stakes
In AccountView.swift, fix totalStaked computed property (line 143) to correctly calculate stake totals - group settled bets by ticketId, use first bet's stake for groups where isParlay is true
Existing singles behavior must remain unchanged (stakes still sum correctly)
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Fix Force-Unwrapped URLs in OddsAPIService
userStories.description: As a user, I need the app to handle invalid API keys gracefully so the app doesn't crash when URL construction fails.
acceptanceCriteria: In OddsAPIService.swift, replace force-unwrapped URL(string:)! with safe URL construction using guard let
Add URL encoding for the API key parameter using addingPercentEncoding(withAllowedCharacters: .urlQueryAllowed)
Throw OddsAPIError.networkError or create new OddsAPIError.invalidURL case when URL construction fails
Fix all three URL constructions: fetchSports (line 97), fetchOdds (line 128), fetchScores (line 167)
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Fix WeeklySettlementView Date Calculation Crash
userStories.description: As a bookie, I need the weekly settlement view to load reliably without crashing due to date calculations.
acceptanceCriteria: In WeeklySettlementView.swift (line 256), replace force-unwrapped date calculation with safe unwrapping using guard let
Provide sensible fallback (use today as fallback) if calendar.date(byAdding:) returns nil
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Make BetSlipManager Thread-Safe
userStories.description: As a user, I need the bet slip to work reliably without crashes when updates come from different threads.
acceptanceCriteria: In BetSlipManager.swift, add @MainActor annotation to the BetSlipManager class
Verify all @Published property updates will now happen on main thread due to @MainActor
Ensure no compiler errors from call sites (may need to wrap some calls in MainActor.run)
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Fix Parlay Stake Assumption Bug
userStories.description: As a bookie, I need parlay payout calculations to be robust so that payouts are always correct even when edge cases occur.
acceptanceCriteria: In ParlayGradingService.swift (lines 101, 108), add guard check to ensure bets array is not empty before accessing bets.first
Return .zero for payout when bets array is empty
Add inline comment: '// All parlay legs share the same stake - use first bet's stake'
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Add Player Relationship Validation in Bet Settlement
userStories.description: As a bookie, I need all bets to have valid player relationships so that settlement always creates correct ledger entries.
acceptanceCriteria: In GradingService.swift (around line 73-74), add logging when player relationship is missing: print("WARNING: Bet \(bet.id) has no player relationship")
Ensure orphaned bets are flagged in the settlement result rather than silently skipped
The existing guard let player = bet.player else return should log before returning
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Handle Missing Player in RealtimeService Bet Sync
userStories.description: As a user, I need bet sync to handle race conditions gracefully so that bets are not silently dropped.
acceptanceCriteria: In RealtimeService.swift (lines 410-414), add logging when a bet update arrives but the associated player is not found locally
Ensure the bet record is still created/updated with nil player so it can be fixed on next full sync
Set needsSync = true on such bets so they get re-processed
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Add Empty Bet Array Validation in Views
userStories.description: As a user, I need ticket details to display correctly even if edge cases create empty tickets.
acceptanceCriteria: In TicketDetailView.swift (lines 209, 642), add guard checks before accessing bets.first?.stake
In TrackView.swift (line 74), add guard check before accessing bets.first?.stake
Display 'No bets' or show $0.00 gracefully when bet array is empty instead of crashing
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Add Silent Failure Logging in AuthManager
userStories.description: As a developer, I need to know when player ID conversion fails so authentication issues can be diagnosed.
acceptanceCriteria: In AuthManager.swift (lines 101-108), add logging when UUID(uuidString:) conversion fails
Log should include the invalid userId value: print("WARNING: Failed to convert userId to UUID: \(userId)")
Keep existing behavior (silent failure for user) but make it observable in logs
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Add Odds Validation in LiabilityService
userStories.description: As a bookie, I need liability calculations to handle invalid odds gracefully.
acceptanceCriteria: In LiabilityService.swift (lines 12-21), add validation that odds are non-zero before calculating
Add validation that odds are within reasonable range (-10000 to +10000 for American odds)
Return zero payout for invalid odds and log a warning
Typecheck passes
